# VRCFaceTracking SDK reference

`5.2.3.0/VRCFaceTracking.Core.dll` is the unmodified assembly from the official
VRCFaceTracking 5.2.3.0 x64 release. It is retained only as the compile-time API
reference for the Galaxy XR custom module and is not copied beside that module.

- Release archive SHA-256: `CD711A1E1AA20A8EBFB7A1CD13B0C671BF237AD678EE175DF230F753B315541F`
- Core DLL SHA-256: `3D04AA1392BD495B05FC8B844596D1B24A8FAAEAB34493851D9437931A2E4601`
- SDK DLL SHA-256: `7DB9C7F05C5D5AC8F6A2C584F9508D514643DA8D63CE6F1C00EF28D7B84D8150`
- Upstream license: `../LICENSE`

The exact, hash-gated acquisition process is in
`tools/Acquire-VRCFT-5.2.3-SDK.ps1`.
